app.name: ATLAS
app.tagline: The AI business operating system for small businesses

demo.banner: Demo data anchored to {date}. New entries use the real current time.

onboarding.title: Welcome to ATLAS
onboarding.subtitle: Set up your business in under a minute. ATLAS will start working for you today.
onboarding.stepBusinessType: What kind of business do you run?
onboarding.useDemoData: Start with demo data so I can explore
onboarding.useDemoDataHint: You can clear it anytime in Settings.

dashboard.title: Today
dashboard.greeting: Here is your business at a glance, {name}
dashboard.judgmentSafe: Today you took in {revenue} and spent {expenses}, keeping {profit}. Cash is safe for the next 7 days — keep the momentum.
dashboard.judgmentWatch: Today you took in {revenue} and spent {expenses}, keeping {profit}. A tight day is coming within 7 days — review the top action below.
dashboard.judgmentDanger: Today you took in {revenue} and spent {expenses}, keeping {profit}. Cash may dip below your safety line of {safety} — act on the top action now.
dashboard.meaningProfit: After costs, this is what you actually kept today.
dashboard.meaningCash: This is the money you can use right now.
dashboard.riskSafe: Cash looks safe for the next 7 days.
dashboard.riskWatch: Watch closely — a tight day is coming.
dashboard.riskDanger: Action needed — cash may drop below your safety line.
dashboard.summaryOnly: You are seeing a limited summary based on your role.

action.executeConfirmBody: ATLAS will record this action and write an audit log. In this demo nothing is actually sent.

actions.title: Action Center
actions.subtitle: ATLAS drafts the work. You approve and stay in control.
actions.empty: No pending actions. You are all caught up.
actions.draftFirst: ATLAS prepares a draft first. Nothing is sent until you approve.

ask.title: Ask ATLAS
ask.subtitle: Ask about money, customers, staff or what to do next.
ask.placeholder: e.g. How much did I make today?

samples.revenue: How much did I make today?
samples.profitDrop: Why did profit drop this month?
samples.payroll: Can I afford payroll next week?
samples.churn: Which customers are about to leave?
samples.staffing: How many people should I schedule tomorrow?

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.subtitle: Every dollar in and out, organised.
ledger.noTransactions: No transactions yet. Add your first one.

capture.title: Receipt Capture
capture.subtitle: Snap a receipt. ATLAS reads it for you.
capture.uploadHint: Tap to take a photo or upload a receipt
capture.lowConfidenceWarning: Please double-check the highlighted fields before saving.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Your people, their shifts and tasks.
team.privacyNotice: Employee location and geofence attendance require explicit employee consent.
team.consentOwnerNote: Only the employee can grant or revoke this consent.
team.privateRedacted: Private contact details are hidden for your role.

schedule.title: Schedule Builder
schedule.subtitle: Cover every shift without overspending.
schedule.toastGenerated: AI schedule draft created in Action Center

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Know who is loyal, who is leaving.

reports.title: Monthly Report
reports.subtitle: Your business diagnosis in plain language.
reports.headline: One-line summary
reports.headlineBody: Revenue held steady this month while costs crept up; protect your margin and chase overdue receivables.
reports.good1: Weekend sales are your strongest channel and still growing.
reports.good2: High-value customers keep returning and lift the average ticket.
reports.good3: Receipt capture keeps your books up to date with little effort.
reports.alert1: Overdue receivables are tying up cash you could use now.
reports.alert2: Raw-material costs are above the peer benchmark.
reports.profitChangeBody: Profit moved mainly because raw-material costs rose faster than revenue this month.
reports.cashflowRiskBody: A tight window appears next week when supplier payments and payroll overlap.
reports.teamSummaryBody: Staffing matched demand on weekdays; weekends were occasionally understaffed.
reports.customerSummaryBody: A few loyal customers drive most revenue; one dormant account is worth winning back.
reports.mostImportant: The one thing for next month
reports.mostImportantBody: Collect the overdue receivables and renegotiate raw-material pricing.
reports.advisorLanguageNote: Report language follows your AI advisor language: {language}

network.title: Peer Network
network.subtitle: Compare with similar businesses, anonymously.
network.anonymityNotice: All peer data is aggregated and anonymised. No single business can be identified.
network.kAnonymityBlocked: Not enough similar businesses yet to show this anonymously (need at least {min}).

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Languages, formats, privacy and compliance.
settings.roleSimulatorHint: Preview ATLAS as a different role. This changes what you can see and do.
settings.demoModeHint: When on, dates are anchored so the sample data stays consistent.
settings.languageIndependentNote: Your interface language and AI advisor language are independent. For example, browse in Chinese while ATLAS writes reports in English.

compliance.disclaimer: ATLAS provides business assistance information and does not replace a certified accountant, lawyer, tax advisor or licensed financial advisor.

pricing.title: Plans
pricing.freeDesc: Daily cashflow, ledger and AI answers for a single owner.
pricing.proDesc: Action Center, receipts, schedules and monthly reports for a small team.
pricing.businessDesc: Multi-role permissions, peer network and data export for growing teams.

validation.positiveAmount: Amount must be greater than zero

answer.finance: Today you brought in {revenue} and spent {expenses}, so you kept about {profit}.
answer.cashflowSafe: You can cover the period ahead. Your lowest projected cash is {lowest}, above your safety line of {safety}.
answer.cashflowRisk: Money gets tight soon. Your projected cash dips to {lowest}, below your safety line of {safety}.
answer.customers: {count} customers look at risk of leaving and are worth contacting.
answer.staffing: {present} of {total} people are clocked in. For tomorrow, about {suggested} on shift looks right.
answer.draft: I drafted a message for you to review before anything is sent.
answer.report: I can put together a plain-language monthly report for you.
answer.peer: Here is how you compare with similar businesses, anonymously.
answer.compliance: Here is general guidance — but please confirm specifics with a qualified professional.
answer.unknown: I'm not sure yet. Try asking about revenue, cashflow, customers or staff.

ev.draftFirst: Nothing is sent until you approve the draft.
ev.reportScope: Covers revenue, costs, cashflow, team and customers.
ev.anonymity: All comparisons are aggregated and anonymised.

risk.negativeProfit: You spent more than you earned today.
risk.cashflowDanger: Cash may fall below your safety line within the forecast window.
risk.churn: Some loyal customers haven't returned recently.

collectPayment.title: Chase {count} overdue receivables
collectPayment.reason: {amount} is overdue and tying up cash you could use now.
collectPayment.draft: Hi, just a friendly reminder that an invoice for {amount} is now past due. Could you let us know when payment will arrive? Thank you!
collectPayment.ev1: 1 receivable is past its due date.
collectPayment.ev2: Collecting frees up {amount} of working cash.

winback.title: Win back a lapsed regular
winback.reason: A {visits}-visit regular hasn't returned in {days} days.
winback.draft: Hi! We've missed you lately. Come back this week and enjoy a little something on us — we'd love to see you again.

delayPayment.title: Request a short supplier extension
delayPayment.reason: Delaying {amount} by {days} days smooths a tight cash day.
delayPayment.draft: Hi, we value our partnership. Could we extend this {amount} payment by {days} days? We'll confirm the new date in writing.
delayPayment.ev1: A payment of {amount} falls on a tight cash day.

tightCash.title: Cash gets tight next week
tightCash.summary: Supplier payments and payroll overlap with overdue receivables.
tightCash.ev2: A payable falls due the same week.
tightCash.ev3: Payroll is scheduled within the window.
